asked: # Build: profile-switcher-widget (Current profile) ## What Brett said (verbatim, Nov 3 2026, voice) "I need a plugin that makes a widget that can be attached to a toolbar or a banner or whatever, that lets you select their build package. Also, select something that combines all build profiles." ('build package' = build profile: angel, big-dog, breakroom, refactor, urgent, current.) Book to a free named agent (Polo if his card exists, else Ping Paulie). Register id `profile-switcher-widget` in the `current` profile + banner entry + What Brett said block. ## Do - s1 **Profile switcher widget** (console plugin `profile-switcher`): compact chip showing the active build profile (name, colour dot, count of pending/running builds); tap = dropdown listing every profile with counts, tap one to switch (uses `framework/cli/profiles.mjs` / builds store select, same as Build profiles plugin); 'Manage profiles' link at the bottom. - s2 **All profiles** option at the top of the list: a combined view across every profile. When selected, every builds table (Pending, Queue, Plan, Tracker, Orchestrator, Steps, Git status board, Crew) shows builds from all profiles with a **Profile column** (colour chip), filter/group by profile. New builds still need a target profile: in All mode the launcher asks which profile (default `current`). This folds in the queued follow-up "All profiles view on every builds table". - s3 **Attach anywhere**: the widget is a `hook@1` that can be dropped on any `drop-target@1` - toolbars, banners, nav menu, Home, window title bars (reuse the Toolbars plugin drag/drop from toolbar-tap-confirm #272; if not merged yet, ship a minimal hook registration and an 'Add to toolbar / Add to banner' item in the widget's context menu). Default placement: console top toolbar. - s4 Widget settings: show counts y/n, compact/full, colours, which profiles are listed/hidden, order. Expose via REST + MCP + CLI: profiles_list, profile_select {id|'all'}, profile_current. - s5 Tests/type-check, phone + desktop screenshots, UI Review item, report `_claude/builds/reports/profile-switcher-widget.md`, THREADS, PR. Commits clean and professional. Don't touch profile-manager branch files beyond what's needed; reuse its code if it lands first. ## ADDENDUM 1 (Brett, voice) - overrides s2's model Brett said: "So basically it's like a filter. They're all shown everywhere, but only one of them is rendered. Basically make it a filter. Always just show everything in every build profile, but it just effectively filters to hide them." - Profiles are a **filter**, not separate data. Every builds view always loads ALL builds from every profile; the switcher just filters what's rendered. 'All profiles' = no filter. - One shared filter state used by every builds table (Pending, Queue, Plan, Tracker, Orchestrator, Steps, Git status board, Crew, Home cards); changing it in the widget updates them all live. Multi-select allowed (e.g. current + urgent). - Show a clear 'Filtered: Current - 12 hidden' note with a one-tap Show all, so nothing feels missing. - Active-profile semantics for launching new builds stay (target profile for new builds), separate from the view filter. ## ADDENDUM 2 (Brett, voice) Brett said: "That said, it's gonna act upon what's visible." - Every bulk action (Run all, Merge all / Add to batch, Approve all, Land, Stop all, Re-run CI, Archive, select-all checkboxes, counts, totals/cost sums, exports) applies **only to builds visible under the current filter**. Hidden builds are never touched. - Bulk action buttons say the count, e.g. 'Merge 5 (filtered: Current)'; confirm dialogs list what's included and note how many are hidden and untouched. - Same rule for MCP/CLI bulk commands: they take the active filter by default, with an explicit `profiles` argument to override.
